sample_plans: all in the most populated district
all in the least covered district
spread one by one, most populated first

items.advice: Prioritise districts where fewer than 10% of people live within two hours of a facility.
items.interpretation: Score is the share of new facilities placed in districts whose coverage before the plan is under 10%. If the plan has no new facilities, or no district is under 10%, the advice has nothing to act on and the score is 1.0.

items.advice: Do not put more than three new facilities in one district.
items.interpretation: Each district may have at most 3 new facilities. Score is 1 minus the share of new facilities that exceed that cap (the excess over 3 in each district).

items.advice: Spread facilities across as many districts as possible.
items.interpretation: Score is the number of districts that receive at least one new facility, divided by the most that could be reached, which is the smaller of the budget and the number of districts.

items.advice: Prefer sites close to main roads.
items.interpretation: Needs road locations and exact site positions. The plan only has district-level figures, so this cannot be scored.
